textHintWeb: Original pixels are preserved until you edit text. Edited text uses the web editor's font, and the saved preview matches the export.
replaceHintWeb: Upload a replacement image. Its placement is retained when you save.
replacementReady: Replacement uploaded. Save changes to apply it.
title: Layer editor
waiting: Open a completed layer project to begin.
canvas: Layer composition. Select a layer, then drag or use arrow keys to move it.
dragHint: Drag a layer to move it. Arrow keys move 1 px; Shift moves 10 px. Save before exporting.
name: Layer name
textHint: Original pixels are preserved until you edit text. Font and layout are approximate; a local font file can improve matching. Saved previews and exports use the same renderer.
replaceHint: Enter an absolute image path on the plugin host. The file is copied into the project when saved; its placement is retained.
dirtyBlocked: Save or discard the draft first.
incoming: A newer result is available. Save or discard your draft before reloading.
timeout: The connection timed out. Reload the project to check whether the operation completed.
error.conflict: The project changed elsewhere. Keep your draft, reload the latest version, then review and save again.
error.invalid_request: Check the field values and local file paths.
error.not_found: This project, version or layer could not be found.
error.invalid_image: Choose an existing local PNG, JPG or WebP image within the size limits.
error.invalid_result: A complete layer result with saved files and stacking order is required.
error.missing_coordinates: A layer has no valid placement coordinates. Its position cannot be guessed.
error.invalid_geometry: Layer size or position is outside the supported range.
error.invalid_asset: A project asset could not be read safely.
error.font_unavailable: No suitable local font was found. Specify an absolute TTF, OTF or TTC font path.
error.task_not_ready: The existing generation task has not succeeded yet.
error.unknown: The operation failed. Reload the project and try again.
noOcr: This layer has no regular text recognized by OCR.
draftKept: Latest version loaded. Your changed fields are retained for review.
